source: Attack: how long the sound takes to fade in from silence to full volume.
translation: Napad (attack): koliko traje da zvuk iz tišine naraste do pune jačine.

source: Decay: how long it takes to fall from full volume to the sustain level.
translation: Pad (decay): koliko traje da jačina padne sa pune na nivo zadržavanja.

source: How long the sound lasts, in seconds.

source: Noise mix: blends a layer of hiss under the tone. Zero is a clean tone.
translation: Primesa šuma: dodaje sloj šištanja ispod tona. Nula je čist ton.

source: How high the sound ends. Lower than the start slides down; higher slides up.
translation: Koliko visoko zvuk završava. Niže od početka klizi naniže, više naviše.

source: How high the sound starts, in hertz (Hz). Higher numbers are higher notes.
translation: Koliko visoko zvuk počinje, u hercima (Hz). Veći broj je viši ton.

source: Pulse width: 50% is a plain square wave; lower or higher values make a thinner, buzzier tone.

source: Release: how long the sound takes to fade out at the end.
translation: Otpuštanje (release): koliko traje da zvuk utihne na kraju.

source: Sustain: the volume held after the decay, as a share of full volume.
translation: Zadržavanje (sustain): jačina koja se drži posle pada, kao deo pune jačine.

source: Fine tune: shifts every note up or down in cents (100 cents = one semitone).
translation: Fino podešavanje: pomera sve note naviše ili naniže u centima (100 centi = polustepen).

source: How loud the sound is. A safe limit is always applied.
translation: Koliko je zvuk glasan. Uvek važi bezbedna granica.

source: The character of the tone: Square is buzzy and retro, Triangle is soft, Saw is bright, Sine is pure, Noise is hiss and crash.
translation: Karakter tona: kvadrat je zujav i retro, trougao je mek, testera je svetla, sinus je čist, šum je šištanje i prasak.

source: An instrument has no fixed pitch. It plays the note you press, so pitch and glide come from the note.

source: Animated sprites need the frame timeline editor.
translation: Za uređivanje animiranog sprajta potreban je uređivač vremenske linije kadrova.

source: Your sprites could not be loaded.
translation: Tvoji sprajtovi nisu mogli da se učitaju.

source: Your drawing is not saved. Close the editor and lose it?
translation: Crtež nije sačuvan. Zatvoriti uređivač i izgubiti ga?

source: Pencil draws, Eraser clears, Fill floods, Rectangle drags a block, Move view pans the canvas. Arrows move the cursor, Enter paints. B/E/I/G/R tools, [ and ] zoom, Ctrl or ⌘ + Z undo.
translation: Olovka crta, gumica briše, kantica popunjava, pravougaonik crta blok, Pomeri pogled pomera platno. Strelice pomeraju kursor, Enter crta. B/E/I/G/R alati, [ i ] zum, G mreža, Ctrl ili ⌘ + Z opovrgni.

source: Your drawing stays centred. A smaller size crops the edges.
translation: Crtež ostaje u sredini. Manja veličina iseca ivice.

notes: Keep UI labels concise. Keep placeholders exactly: {size}

source: The sprite was not saved. Please try again.
This sprite changed in another tab. Close and open it again to load the newest version.
translation: Sprite je izmenjen u drugoj kartici. Zatvori ga i otvori ponovo da učitaš najnoviju verziju.

source: This browser cannot save. Keep your code before closing.
translation: Ovaj pregledač ne može da čuva. Sačuvaj kod pre zatvaranja.
